description: Real-Time Weather Integration - Add WeatherWidget component showing current weather + 7-day forecast using OpenWeatherMap API (free tier), integrated into DestinationSummary component
steps: 1. Install OpenWeatherMap dependency: Run 'npm install axios' (if not already installed) for HTTP requests to OpenWeatherMap API
2. Add VITE_OPENWEATHER_API_KEY to .env.local file (user must provide their own free OpenWeatherMap API key from openweathermap.org/api)

3. Create src/services/openWeatherService.ts: Implement fetchCurrentWeather(lat, lon) and fetchSevenDayForecast(lat, lon) functions using OpenWeatherMap Current Weather API and One Call API 3.0 (free tier). Handle errors gracefully with fallback to existing weatherService.ts mock data if API fails or key is missing.

4. Create src/components/WeatherWidget.tsx: Display current weather (temp, condition, icon) and 7-day forecast cards. Accept destinationId prop to get coordinates from destination data. Use Tailwind classes matching project design (blue accent, white cards, rounded-2xl). Follow existing WeatherForecast.tsx pattern for layout and styling but simplified for widget format.

5. Update src/components/DestinationSummary.tsx: Import and render WeatherWidget below the 'Quick Info Grid' section, passing destination coordinates. Add conditional rendering if weather data unavailable.
6. Update src/types/search.ts or create src/types/weather.ts: Add TypeScript interfaces for OpenWeatherMap API responses (CurrentWeather, ForecastDay, WeatherResponse)
7. Test temperature unit toggle (C/F) functionality in WeatherWidget, matching WeatherForecast.tsx pattern
acceptance_criteria: WeatherWidget displays current weather with temperature, condition icon, and description
7-day forecast shown as horizontal scrollable cards with daily high/low temps
Widget appears in DestinationSummary for all destinations with coordinates
Falls back gracefully to mock data or hidden state if API key missing or API fails
TypeScript compilation passes with npm run lint
Production build succeeds with npm run build
verification: Run 'npm run lint' - must pass with no TypeScript errors
Run 'npm run build' - must build successfully
Manual test: Generate trip for Goa, scroll to DestinationSummary, verify WeatherWidget appears with current temp and 7-day forecast
Manual test: Toggle temperature unit between C and F, verify all temps update
Manual test: Remove VITE_OPENWEATHER_API_KEY from .env.local, verify widget either hides or shows fallback message (no crash)
